"We’re sorry you’re having trouble with your discount code. Let’s explore what might be causing this.
1. Is your discount code expired? Make sure that you’re trying to apply it before the expiration date. If there isn’t information about the expiration, it means your discount doesn’t expire.
2. Is there a typo? Adding extra spaces while typing or pasting the code, or changing capital letters will make your discount invalid.
3. Do you already have a discount code applied? Please note that only one box discount can be applied at a time.
If you still have questions/troubles with your discount code, please reach out to us via the \"\"contact us\"\" page linked at the bottom."
